name: pdf-cutter
description: 把大 PDF 按页数、大小或自定义范围切成小份，方便分批上传给 Claude。
author: Mongxin

scripts.dist: npm run icon && tauri build -- --locked && node scripts/collect-artifacts.js
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icon && tauri build --bundles dmg -- --locked && node scripts/collect-artifacts.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run icon && tauri build --bundles nsis -- --locked && node scripts/collect-artifacts.js
